name: @glideapps/glide-data-grid
vendoredFrom: node_modules/@glideapps/glide-data-grid/src (the npm package ships its TypeScript source)
modifications: Trimmed cell renderers to marker/new-row/boolean/loading/text; dropped image, markdown, number, bubble, drilldown, uri, protected and row-id renderers plus their private overlay editors, markdown-div, and the marked / react-number-format / react-responsive-carousel dependencies.
Replaced lodash imports (clamp, range, uniq, flatten, debounce, throttle, groupBy, has) with common/collection-utils.ts.
Stripped @linaria styled components: each became a plain element with a semantic gdg-* class; rules live in styles.css (imported by the app instead of dist/index.css).
OverlayImageEditorProps kept as a standalone type (internal/data-grid-overlay-editor/overlay-image-editor-props.ts) because the editor-callback contract references it.
index.ts re-created as the trimmed public facade; docs, stories and unused entry points omitted.
Subsequent commits add native merged-cell support; see git history of this directory.

Row moves (row and column structure design, delivery step 7): onRowMoved now reports a block and the row it lands before, `(rows: { start, end }, before)`. A marker drag arms only when a plain primary press lands inside the current contiguous row selection (and the new canMoveRows allows it); the armed press is withheld from the data editor and replayed on release if the pointer never passed the 20 px threshold, so drag-to-select, menus, touch, and resize from any other press are unchanged. The new onRowProposeMove refuses a drop target (not-allowed cursor via the new DataGrid isDragRefused prop). A drop shows a 2 px indicator between rows (drawn through a wrapped drawCell, the trailing append row excluded) instead of upstream's live single-row reorder preview; computeCanBlit now treats a changed drawCell as a reason to redraw rather than blit stale pixels; and the pointer within one row height (at most half the body height) of the top or bottom edge auto-scrolls through useAutoscroll. Markers no longer draw a drag handle or select only through their checkbox when onRowMoved is set.

Column moves (row and column structure design, delivery step 8): onColumnMoved and onColumnProposeMove now report a block and the column it lands before, `(columns: { start, end }, before)`, in data columns. A header drag arms only when a plain primary press lands inside the current contiguous column selection (and the new canMoveColumns allows it); the armed press is withheld and replayed on release if the pointer never passed the 20 px threshold, so drag-to-select from any other header is unchanged. Upstream's single-column drag with a live reorder preview is removed. A 2 px vertical indicator marks the drop (through wrapped drawCell and drawHeader; a left-edge indicator spans one more pixel because the grid line is painted over a column's first pixel); a drop at or past the visible right edge targets the column at that edge, and the end only once the last column is fully in view; the hit test walks from the first visible column; and the pointer within one column width (at most half the scrollable width, so a wide column cannot reverse the drag) of the left or right edge auto-scrolls through useAutoscroll.

Accessibility labels: the new getColumnAccessibilityLabel sets each column header's aria-label, and DataGridSearch, ScrollingDataGrid, and DataGridDnd now forward it and getRowAccessibilityLabel to DataGrid (the row label previously stopped at DataGridSearch).
